cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

mechanism: A teaches its baking pupil a self-serving accounting system that makes A larger slice and earlier icing consumption compatible with supposedly equal shares.
confusable: Not openly abandoning fairness: A agrees only after moving A labour and consumed icing into advantageous accounting categories.
comparison: Compensated race start versus labour-adjusted cake shares.
